lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-intensity circular clusters arranged in four to five staggered horizontal rows posterior to the fifth gill slit, with higher density in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with primary blobs to create a non-uniform grid-like pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three visible longitudinal ridges running horizontally; the primary ridge displays a sharp luminance gradient transition with light exposure on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, elongated white mark with high pixel intensity is located anterior to the first gill slit; numerous small, high-contrast white specks are scattered across the head and gill regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Pectoral fin displays a distinct distribution of smaller, lower-intensity spots concentrated toward the leading edge.
